property_summary: For every caller and deposit key, when withdraw() is invoked the reference contract sends the caller the entire balance recorded for that caller (so address(c).balance decreases by that amount and c.balances(caller) becomes 0), whereas the mutant that sends value 0 does not transfer funds out of the contract so address(c).balance does not decrease accordingly — there exists inputs where the contract balance after withdraw differs between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Replace the external call with sending zero value (no transfer), leaving balances untouched after the function ends which can change observed balances at keys.
